messages:
maria: TenantCorp returned their security questionnaire. Main asks: 2yr WORM audit, FIPS HSM attestation for CMKs, tenant-isolated service accounts with exportable proof, and a 48h critical vuln SLA. Can we scope?

devon: Quick inventory: audit exports + signed manifests = yes. WORM on S3 can be enabled for exports. 48h SLA for Criticals is negotiable with sales (default is 72h).

kei: For attestation: customer BYOK using CloudHSM -> provider can supply attestation certs. For our managed keys we cannot generate HSM attestation; propose: offer BYOK as the path for attestation customers.

sec-bot: Uploaded artifacts: /evidence/tenantcorp/2026-03-15/ (signed-log-manifest.tar.gz, redacted-rbac.csv.asc). Check ACLs before sharing.

maria: Can we produce a short verification checklist for auditors (hash chain, object-lock headers, GPG signature check)? If so we can mark attestation as pending and provide mitigations.

devon: Yep. Checklist will include: `aws s3api head-object --bucket X --key Y` to check object lock; `gpg --verify file.asc`; compare SHA256 in manifest. I'll drop a draft in the artifact dir.

kei: Action items: 1) Sales to confirm SLA uplift + PO for BYOK cost; 2) Produce RBAC export + signed CSV (devon); 3) Draft auditor verification steps (devon); 4) Note attestation pending if using managed keys (maria).

sales-ops: I'll reach out to procurement and ask about BYOK cost acceptance and timeline. Expect reply in 24-48h.

maria: Thanks. If anyone hits blockers, ping here. We'll aim to deliver evidence packet in 48h and mark HSM attestation as vendor-dependent pending. :thumbsup:
